sources.use: Existing Python3.12.14 standard-library producer/listener pipeline; separate background I/O, own allowlisted JSON messages.
Official recipe for separating handlers that can block from caller work.
Existing Qt6.11.2 visible application surfaces, not file/title counts.

choice: Use mature installed standard-library/Qt facilities. A separate external telemetry backend or full tracing framework adds deployment/network/maintenance cost beyond this local Gate 0 scope.
